p1.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Soft-finish knit with a 65% polyester main fabric.
  • Family story: One bright Halloween pajama look for mom, dad, and the kids, made for pumpkin carving, trick-or-treat mornings, and family photos.
  • Print: Boo Stripe pairs a bold orange top with white BOO! lettering and orange-and-white striped pants covered in jack-o'-lantern balloons and Halloween script.
  • Design details: Long-sleeve crew-neck top with striped raglan sleeves, plus full-length striped pants with cuffed ankles.
  • Care: Follow the care instructions on the sewn-in garment label.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 10-11 Years, Mother S through Mother 2XL, and Father M through Father 3XL.

Boo Stripe brings the whole family into the Halloween spirit with the same two-piece pajama set in child, women's, and men's sizes. Choose each person's size separately to build the matching family look you need.

Each size is one two-piece set with a top and pants. Garment length is the top length; pant length is the full pants length. The chart has no hip measurement. Measurements are taken by hand and can vary by 1-3 cm. Child sizes are labeled by age, and the Child 3-4 Years and Child 4-5 Years sizes overlap at age 4, so compare chest, waist, and lengths with pajamas that fit well.

Key Features:

  • Whole-family match: One Halloween pajama set in child sizes plus women's and men's cuts.
  • BOO! graphic top: Big white BOO! lettering on a bright orange long-sleeve top.
  • Striped Halloween pants: Orange and white stripes with jack-o'-lantern balloons and Halloween script.
  • Soft-finish knit: A polyester-blend knit for cozy fall and winter bedtimes.
  • Family size range: Six child sizes, five women's sizes, and five men's sizes; see the size chart for measurements.

Choose the sizes you need for a cheerful Boo Stripe family Halloween.

Trick or Treat brings the whole family into the Halloween spirit with the same two-piece pajama set in child, women's, and men's sizes. Choose each person's size separately to build the matching family look you need.

Each size is one two-piece set with a top and pants. Body measurements are shown in inches and child heights in centimeters. Garment length is the top length; pant length is the full pants length; waist and hip are pants measurements, and the chart has no child hip measurement. Child sizes are labeled by age with a suggested height range, so check height first, then compare chest, waist, and lengths with pajamas that fit well.

Key Features:

  • Whole-family match: One Halloween pajama set in child sizes plus women's and men's cuts.
  • Trick or Treat graphic top: Orange lettering with bats and cobwebs on a black long-sleeve top.
  • Pumpkin and ghost pants: Jack-o'-lanterns, white ghosts, crescent moons, and bats on black.
  • Soft polyester knit: A regular-weight knit for cozy fall bedtimes.
  • Family size range: Six child sizes, five women's sizes, and five men's sizes; see the size chart for measurements.

Choose the sizes you need for a spooky-sweet Trick or Treat family Halloween.

p3.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Warm, thick polyester knit with a relaxed fit.
  • Family story: One cozy Christmas sweater for mom, dad, and the kids, made for tree trimming, holiday mornings, and family photos.
  • Print: Christmas Reindeer knits a green chest band of red reindeer and white Christmas trees onto a red sweater, with white reindeer and trees below and rows of white snowflake dots.
  • Design details: Long-sleeve jacquard-knit pullover with a crew neck and ribbed neckline, cuffs, and hem.
  • Care: Machine washable; follow the sewn-in garment label for temperature and drying.
  • Size range: Child 4-5 Years through Child 10-12 Years, and Adult S-M through Adult XL-2XL.

Christmas Reindeer brings the whole family together in the same red holiday sweater, cut in child and adult sizes. Choose each person's size separately to build the matching Christmas look you need.

Each selection is one sweater. Adult sizes span two standard sizes (for example, S-M covers sizes S and M), and child sizes are labeled by age. All measurements are garment measurements in centimeters, and chest is the full chest circumference. Shoulder width is 30–37 cm for children and 44–50 cm for adults; the hem circumference is 66–84 cm for children and 100–120 cm for adults. Compare chest, sleeve, and length with a sweater that fits well.

Key Features:

  • Whole-family match: One Christmas sweater design in child and adult sizes.
  • Reindeer jacquard knit: Red and white reindeer, Christmas trees, and snowflake rows knitted into the sweater.
  • Warm holiday layer: A thick knit with a relaxed pullover fit for cold December days.
  • Easy care: Machine washable for busy holiday weeks.
  • Family size range: Four child sizes and four adult sizes; see the size chart for measurements.

Choose the sizes you need for cozy matching Christmas Reindeer sweaters this holiday season.

Polar Bear Christmas dresses the whole family in the same red holiday sweater, in child sizes and unisex adult sizes for mom and dad. Choose each person's size separately to build the matching family look you need.

Each adult size covers two letter sizes (S/M, M/L, L/XL, XL/2XL) in a loose, relaxed cut. Measurements are garment measurements in centimeters; chest is the full chest circumference. Hip and waist measurements are unavailable, and the chart gives no weight or height guidance, so compare the chest, sleeve, and garment-length measurements with a sweater that fits well.

Key Features:

  • Whole-family match: One Christmas sweater in child sizes plus unisex adult sizes.
  • Polar bear holiday design: White polar bears in Santa hats with a green Christmas tree, gifts, and snowflakes on red.
  • Thick polyester knit: A warm, heavier-weight knit for cold-weather gatherings.
  • Relaxed pullover: A loose-cut crew-neck pullover with long sleeves.
  • Family size range: Four child sizes and four adult sizes; see the size chart for measurements.
